name: Create Billing Document
objective: Create, save, and post a Billing Document (invoice) referencing the Outbound Delivery created in the previous stage.
preconditions: The delivery has completed Post Goods Issue and has no outstanding Proof-of-Delivery requirement blocking billing.
learningObjectives: After this section you can locate a delivery in the "due for billing" worklist and create its billing document.
After this section you can distinguish a temporary billing document number from a final one.
After this section you can post a billing document to complete the accounting entry.
commonErrorsAndTips: Searching by the wrong reference. The "SD Document" filter accepts sales order, delivery, or order numbers — for this flow, always search by the Delivery number, since billing is delivery-based, not order-based.

Assuming the number shown right after "Create Billing Documents" is final. It is a temporary placeholder (e.g., TMP0000689) until Save is clicked — do not record it as the invoice number yet. Even right after Save, the on-screen header can briefly still display the old temporary number for a moment before it refreshes — re-check rather than reading it the instant Save returns.

Forgetting to click "Post Billing Document." A document with status "To Be Posted" has a real number but has not updated financial accounting. The process is not complete until status shows "Completed."

Billing a delivery that failed Proof of Delivery (POD). Some deliveries show "POD report back not yet carried out or incomplete" and cannot be billed until POD is confirmed — this is a data/configuration condition, not an automation error.
